notes.title: Unique competition, unique prizes. (Polish)
notes.content:
(Polish) 
Announce and Introduction:
[previewyoutube=dlivFQkvUEs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

(Polish) 
By the way, we are pleased to announce the availability of the mobile version of synchronization:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dommain.sychro




📣 Attention, attention! On the occasion of the release of the first chapter of our new game - Synchronization, we are announcing a competition.
➡️ What can you win?
There are two games and materials from behind the scenes of Synchronization to be won. Three people win, but there are different prizes for each place.
🥇 First place: Behind the scenes materials from the Synchronization production process + Aker Fern boxed game + Eternal Secret steam key
🥈 Runner-up: Behind the scenes materials from the Synchronization production process + Aker Fern boxed game
🥉 Third Place: Behind the scenes footage from the Synchronization manufacturing process
➡️ What do I have to do to enter the competition?
You should write a review of Synchronization on the steam platform, having played at least 2 hours on your account.
Once this is done, please send us a link to your steam profile so that we can verify that both conditions are actually met. And also send (preferably in the same message) a contact to yourself - preferably an e-mail address or a discord message.
📩 The message should be sent to one of the following places:
• to our e-mail: chaos.group.games@gmail.com
• in a private message on discord to ZłodziejkaŚwitu # 9596
• in a private message on discord to Gray Griffin # 9358
➡️ Until when?
Until February 25, 2022, at 23.59
➡️ Announcement of the results: February 26, 2022. Scheduled on our YouTube channel at 21.00.
If there are any changes in time, we will keep the participants informed.
➡️ How will the winners be selected?
We plan to organize a thematic live on YT, during which a three-person committee will evaluate the submitted reviews.
➡️ What will be taken into account when rating a review?
We want your review to contain information such as:
• a description of what you like or don't like and why
• Your opinion on specific elements of the game (e.g. music / graphics / plot)
• overall evaluation
You do not have to worry about stylistic and spelling correctness, the message and your feelings related to the game are more important 😉
➡️ Sending us a message that meets the requirements for entering the competition is considered to be your application for participation in the competition and acceptance of the method of determining the winners.
Have a good time,
Chaos Group Games team 😃
(Polish)
